name: libkexiv2
description: Libkexiv2 is a KDE wrapper around the Exiv2 library for manipulating image metadata.

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$KF6_PREFIX \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release         \
      -D BUILD_WITH_QT6=ON                \
      -D BUILD_TESTING=OFF                \
      -W no-dev .
